notes: CDER letter based on a review of records the firm submitted under section 704(a)(4) (no on-site inspection occurred), citing CGMP failures for OTC drug manufacturing: inadequate identity/COA-reliability testing of high-risk components, no process validation, and an ineffective quality unit. All specific drug/component names are redacted as (b)(4), so products is empty and product_redacted is true. location_contains is null because this was a records review, not a facility inspection.
